title: Default prop values (and when they fail)

slides.say: Want a fallback when a prop is missing? Give it a default value.
Put equals and the default right after the name, inside the destructuring. No size passed? Size is one hundred.

slides.text: Only missing or undefined uses the default.
slides.say: Careful. The default kicks in only when the prop is missing or undefined. Null or zero are real values, so the default is not used.

slides.text: null and 0 are values. Only "nothing" triggers the default.
slides.say: Takeaway: null and zero count as values. Only nothing at all triggers the default.
